judgment: The noble one has an ending.
image: A mountain inside the earth: Bowing Low.
So the noble one takes from the much
lines: Low, and low again, the noble one
the noble one has an ending.
It is good to strike and invade.
It is good to march the army out,
to march on towns and states.

notes.name_en: 謙 is deference that lowers itself; 'Bowing Low', not Wilhelm's abstract 'Modesty'.
notes.L2: 鳴謙 humility that is heard/sounds out — 鳴 kept as sounding.
